messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I'm wrapping the ops runbook for the cloud marketplace reference kit (refkit). Need a short pass from infra + partner enablement today. TL;DR: doc + terraform examples + smoke tests.
Oliver: On it. Which parts need infra sign-off vs partner docs?
Maya: Infra: autoscale/policy examples and the required IAM snippets. Partner enablement: onboarding steps, expected artifact layout, and a minimal checklist for the partner.
Sarah: I'll take the onboarding steps and checklist. Can you drop the current draft link?
Maya: https://redwood.internal/docs/refkit/ops-runbook-draft (view-only for now). Main todo: a) add quickstart terraform snippet for a single-region deploy, b) clarify KMS recommendations, c) add canary rollback notes.
Devon: Pinging infra. Oliver — I'll sync with you on autoscale vars. One ask: add an example using spot + reserved mix for cost-conscious partners.
Oliver: Good call. I'll add an example block and a recommended policy. Example snippet (will add to doc):
```
resource "redwood_inference_pool" "partner_default" {
  region = "us-west-2"
  gpu_type = "a100"
  min_instances = 1
  max_instances = 10
  spot_percentage = 60
}
```
Alex: Marketplace note: AMI/container image tag must be immutable. We'll need a note that partners must pin image tags for marketplace packaging. Also add the Verified Models section for model manifest.
Maya: Added a TODO for image pinning and model manifest format. Sarah — for onboarding checklist, include: account setup, KMS key creation, VPC peering/network checklist, smoke test checklist.
Sarah: Draft checklist done and added to doc. Short items only. Example smoke test command: `curl -X POST https://<endpoint>/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'`
Devon: Also include expected latency SLOs and a note about fallback model variant if resources constrained. I can draft numbers.
Maya: Please do. Also include a short rollback playbook: how to flip traffic to hosted fallback, how to revoke keys if needed, contact list.
Oliver: One more: we should surface cost-estimation guidance — rough hourly GPU cost + recommended batching config. I'll add a small table.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: partner submission cutoff for next marketplace release is 2026-04-12 23:59 UTC.
Maya: Thanks bot. That gives us one week. Plan: final doc by EOD Friday, internal review Friday afternoon, submit Monday for packaging.
Alex: I can own packaging checklist and submission artifact (image + manifest).
Sarah: I'll own partner-facing onboarding doc and the quickstart guide.
Devon: I'll own infra examples and the smoke test harness.
Oliver: I'll do the cost + autoscale recommendations.
Maya: Awesome — small follow-ups: 1) everyone drop PRs to the doc by Thursday 5pm, 2) add short snippet of Terraform module usage (module source + inputs) not the whole module.
Sarah: Noted. I'll add example inputs for `refkit_vpc_id`, `kms_key_arn`, and `region`.
Maya: Perfect. If no blockers I'll publish the internal review link by Friday. Thanks all :sparkles:
